## T44 v1 handoff proof and catalogue erratum — 2026-11-02

The two bounded preparation returns are retained and independently reproduced at coordinator `b419ae354c7046de5ee3ddb5d194f51c0ab4dc8e`, under `docs/qa-logs/2026-11-02-m6-resume/t44-preparation/`. This is preparation; T43 remains active and T44 is not executing.

Dated factual correction to comment6375264017: PL-024 changed **35 PO catalogues**, one POT and FileData.cpp: **37 files / 38 exact replacements**, including the en_GB msgstr correction. The older “36 catalogues” and “37 lines” descriptions are superseded by the immutable commit/readback evidence. Historical records remain unchanged.

Candidate: `docs/reviews/briefs/es-vendored-and-data.md` v1 SHA256 `c3cbddc5d0d0bbdaf6b0b04614565f4cd45f85c3586f551e03b742ac31bc5384`; helper `docs/qa-logs/2026-11-02-m6-resume/t44-brief-inputs.py` SHA256 `6670e5e69aaaa5544be4768a142d91e63c80bde476bac034f03ec21e57028096`.

**Existing T5, wN:p7:** prove this handoff under plan §6b/§7. Read this complete thread, #700 and the immutable candidate. From private metadata-only Git state, run its literal membership block in one shell invocation and reconcile the stated quantities/boundaries: native594, separate three post-survey tests/450 lines, four accepted companion branches, primary T2 tree, 40 changed/554 unchanged native identities, survey-versus-primary line/kind/tier distinctions, 35PO/37files/38replacement erratum, and full 5017+450 source-read obligation. Check the proposed primary-plus-companion contract against the existing shared-path note and plan, without choosing a different baseline or merging sources.

Use at most ten top-level reproducible commands, retaining internal argv in any small script. Verify tool interfaces and source existence; use synthetic metadata/tiny private Git controls for selector/recipe drift, missing source, mode/gitlink change, omitted supplemental/companion input and a falsely integrated companion claim where the candidate actually asserts those predicates. Distinguish an assertion the helper enforces from an obligation left for the audit-local table generator. Return concrete correction locations rather than filling unsupported PASS.

Only named immutable Git objects, complete owning issue reads and small private text/JSON/Git metadata scratch are authorized. CPU affinity8–23. No source export or checkout, audit-body sweep, actual T44 audit/generator, accepted producer/test replay, repository/tracker/kit write, shared-ref change, fetch, runtime/compiler/guest, private-held/credential read, host-ledger/provider/device/cloud action or another agent's permission answer. The T38/T42 and historical launch trees stay untouched. Preserve literal preflight failures: two tools do not implement --help; normal read-only interfaces are documented.

Return a concise proof with exact commands, hashes, limitations and any blocker to wN:p2, then stop. This is the required stranger proof, not a reviewer/council verdict or execution dispatch. Root retains v2, final baseline/ownership, criteria, worktree creation, acceptance and dispatch. Can this be done on the VM? These are immutable source/metadata and handoff-interface checks; no runtime behavior is measured.
